$comment: Time-boxed exceptions for npm audit HIGH/CRITICAL advisories. Enforced by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry (max ~60 days). Remove entries as soon as a fixed version is installable. Policy: docs/security/dependency-exceptions.md

exceptions.reason: Transitive dependency of the Prisma CLI (prisma@7.10.0 -> @prisma/config, exact pin 7.1.5). Dev-only tooling, never in the API bundle; merges only our own prisma.config.ts, so no attacker-controlled recursive graphs. npm overrides are not honoured for this exact pin; no newer Prisma 7 patch exists.

Transitive dependency of the Prisma CLI (prisma@7.10.0, exact pin 3.15.3). Used only for MySQL connections; TestPulse uses PostgreSQL exclusively, so the vulnerable code path is never executed. Dev-only tooling.

Only path is @next/eslint-plugin-next@16.3.8 -> fast-glob@3.3.1 -> micromatch -> braces@3.0.3 (root devDependency, ESLint only). It expands glob patterns written in our own config against our own repo files, never user input, and is not in any app bundle. No patched braces release exists (3.0.3 is latest); npm's suggested fix downgrades the plugin to Next 14, which ADR-004 forbids.
